assumption: The configuration via KeySlot resolves the public key only at the execution time of the encapsulation.
rationale: SWS_CRYPT_50012 and error message kEmptyKeySlot in SWS_CRYPT_21813/SWS_CRYPT_50011 refer to the state of the slot during encapsulation execution.

original.rationale: SWS_CRYPT_50012 und Fehlermeldung kEmptyKeySlot in SWS_CRYPT_21813/SWS_CRYPT_50011 verweisen auf den Zustand des Slots bei Kapselungsausführung.
